name: Laura Battley
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Laura Battley, MSc, GDip.Psych(Adv) professional journey is deeply intertwined with her roles as a mother, creative, and clinical psychotherapist. With a profound understanding of the interconnectedness between mind, body, spirit, and soul, Laura's practice spans a spectrum of modalities, ranging from traditional psychotherapy to innovative transpersonal arts therapy and contemporary shamanic practices. As a compassionate guide, Laura leads individuals on transformative journeys of self-discovery, healing, and empowerment.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Kym Anderton
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Kym has been a therapist for 25 years, initially as a Myotherapist, transitioning to psychotherapy and counselling to support individuals and couples to navigate life's challenges, mentally and emotionally. Kym draws from integrative approaches such as Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Attachment Repair, Somatic Experiencing, Trauma Informed Therapy, and other relevant models. Her approach caters to clients with stress, anxiety, depression, relationship disturbances, self-esteem issues, the impact of abuse, trauma, grief and loss, addiction, and other presenting problems.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Laura Solis
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Welcome. I practice with an integrative, humanistic, holistic, existential and trauma informed approach. I work with trauma, anxiety, depression, life transitions, grief & loss, relationship concerns, existential concerns, overwhelm.

name: Al Jeffery
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Al is an integrative psychotherapist aiming to create spaces of trust for clients to explore the intricacy and fullness of their own lives and minds, coming to a greater sense of resilience and compassion within themselves, and their world. Using a collaborative, relational, embodied, and integrative approach, Al has experience supporting clients living with; depression, anxiety, grief and loss, relationship challenges, emotional and relationship disturbance. As a queer man, he offers an inclusive space for LGBTQIA+ folk, and often works with men surrounding topics of masculinity, sexuality and identity.

name: Dr Stine Neerup
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
practice: Relational Therapist, animal-assisted. Be Kids Therapy
description: I am an animal-assisted relational therapist. My approach to therapy is trauma-informed, gender inclusive, neuro-affirming, and collaborative. I see clients with relational issues, trauma, ADHD, autism, a 2E profile, anxiety, OCD, and depression.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Angela Cook
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Therapy offers an opportunity to become curious about ourselves and the ways we are challenged, struggle, engage and process experiences, relationships and the world. I also work with people in post-cult recovery and religious trauma. Working with individuals aged 14+, I practice with a trauma-informed, evidence-based, collaborative and creative focus. I am both LGBTIQA= and Neurodiverse affirming.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy
